meta.description: Orchestrates an untargeted LC-MS metabolomics workflow from xcms feature extraction through QC, confidence-aware annotation, validated statistics, and background-aware pathway mapping.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All reported values were produced by the audited runs or were explicitly synthetic; no DOI, clinical, or numerical fabrication occurred.

practice_boundaries.detail: The workflow is research-only metabolomics analysis and made no individual diagnostic or treatment claim.

methodological_ground.detail: The executed workflow preserves feature orientation, drops wholly missing QCRSC outputs before MNAR imputation, and retains the MSI/background safeguards.

code_usability.detail: All runnable paths executed and produced checked output; the Stage 1 script has an open P1 because it fails to materialize its documented mode column and needs an explicit Windows backend.

functional_suitability.note: All five stages and the MS-DIAL entry path are present and testable; Stage 1 does not implement the advertised defs$mode hand-off.

reliability.note: The Stage 2 recovery path is excellent, but an unconstrained default Stage 1 backend launched 22 Windows RSOCK workers without producing output in the audit window.

performance_context.note: Progressive disclosure is good, but Stage 1 needs an explicit serial or bounded BPPARAM for predictable Windows execution.

agent_usability.note: Stage decisions, checkpoints, scripts, and common-error recovery are clear; the stated mode-lock contract does not match the emitted Stage 1 object.

human_usability.note: The five-stage table, required inputs, and common-error table are actionable.

security.note: No secrets, unsafe evaluation, destructive operations, or sensitive-data disclosure patterns were found.

maintainability.note: Runnable Stage 1, Stage 2, and MS-DIAL scripts are separated from references; the Stage 4 helper remains a cross-skill dependency.

agent_specific.note: The skill gives explicit stop conditions and composable hand-offs, but the mode-lock escape hatch is not actually encoded by the Stage 1 script.

recommendations.title: Materialize and verify the Stage 1 mode lock
recommendations.problem: The current Stage 1 script accepts ionization_mode but ends after featureDefinitions(xdata); it does not add defs$mode despite claiming that it carries the mode downstream.
recommendations.root_cause: The intended defs$mode assignment described in the fix log and script comments was omitted from the executable script.
recommendations.fix: Immediately after featureDefinitions(xdata), set defs$mode <- ionization_mode and assert it is present and non-missing before returning Stage 1 outputs. Add this assertion to the bundled hand-off verification.

recommendations.title: Bound Stage 1 parallel execution on Windows
recommendations.problem: With the default backend, the real six-CDF run launched 22 Windows RSOCK workers and made no useful output during the audit window; serial registration completed successfully.
recommendations.root_cause: The shipped Stage 1 script leaves BiocParallel backend selection implicit.
recommendations.fix: Accept an explicit BPPARAM or register a documented bounded backend before xcms calls, with SerialParam as the safe Windows fallback. Preserve user override for larger hosts.
